levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن يزيد

notes: Partial reading: after «عن ابن أبي ليلى» the text gives «ويزيد بن أبي زياد، عن ابن أبي ليلى» and «وأبو فروة عن عبد الله بن عكيم», then Hudhayfa's words; the text does not say how these routes join the first, so they are not written here and a ruling is needed (rule 9: never guess an extra link)
The Companion حذيفة is the last link of the saying and is not in this partial group
«أبو عيسى» is not in this text; no editor glosses are involved
